Gulliver & typography

Gulliver adapts the user-owned, code-drawn Eastbourne gull from the supplied personal dashboard, adding an explorer’s hat, scarf and suitcase. This is an original character asset, not the College logo. No personal P or C symbols are used.

Nimbus Roman and Nimbus Sans are bundled unmodified from the existing personal homepage. Font copyright, licence and source details.

Content notes

Pompeii news screens use an identified location photograph of the forum, not a photograph of the reported discovery. Automatic feed notices use an original archaeology illustration and a short source extract. Charlotte Higgins uses an original name graphic rather than a portrait. These graphics were drawn in SVG for this display. Career connections are editorial examples of transferable skills, not promises of admission or employment. Gulliver’s remarks are fictional.

When replacing an image, keep the creator, original link, licence and any required adaptation notice with the file. Update this page and assets/credits.json.
